== table alert_state (table alert_state)
CREATE TABLE alert_state (
    name       TEXT   PRIMARY KEY,
    -- NULL for the tool's own (admin) alerts; a deleted project takes its rows along.
    project_id BIGINT REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    -- The period a digest last covered, or the text of the last admin alert.
    value      TEXT   NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    sent_at    BIGINT NOT NULL
)
== table alerts (table alerts)
CREATE TABLE alerts (
    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id BIGINT  NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    -- new_issue, regression, spike or digest.
    kind       TEXT    NOT NULL,
    -- email or slack.
    channel    TEXT    NOT NULL,
    enabled    BOOLEAN NOT NULL,
    -- spike: fire at this many times the usual hourly rate of errors.
    threshold  INTEGER,
    -- digest: daily, weekly or monthly.
    frequency  TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    UNIQUE (project_id, kind, channel)
)
== table api_token_projects (table api_token_projects)
CREATE TABLE api_token_projects (
    token_id   BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES api_tokens (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    project_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    PRIMARY KEY (token_id, project_id)
)
== table api_tokens (table api_tokens)
CREATE TABLE api_tokens (
    id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name         TEXT   NOT NULL,
    token_hash   TEXT   NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    -- The token's last four characters, so admins can tell tokens apart.
    hint         TEXT   NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_by   BIGINT REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    created_at   BIGINT NOT NULL,
    -- When an upload last signed in with it; NULL when never.
    last_used_at BIGINT
)
== table custom_events (table custom_events)
CREATE TABLE custom_events (
    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id BIGINT  NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    -- The event's uuid, so an SDK that sends it again stores it once.
    event_id   TEXT    NOT NULL,
    name       TEXT    NOT NULL,
    -- distinct_id: anonymous until the app calls identify.
    user_id    TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    -- The page it happened on: its path (secrets masked) and route.
    path       TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    route      TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    at         BIGINT  NOT NULL,
    -- Bots are stored but counted apart.
    is_bot     BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    -- The app's own properties (not the SDK's "$" ones), scrubbed, as JSON.
    properties TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    UNIQUE (project_id, event_id)
)
== table error_events (table error_events)
CREATE TABLE error_events (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    issue_id    BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES issues (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    project_id  BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    event_id    TEXT   NOT NULL,
    timestamp   BIGINT NOT NULL,
    received_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
    -- Empty when the SDK sent no user id.
    user_id     TEXT   NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    url         TEXT   NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    route       TEXT   NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    release     TEXT   NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    environment TEXT   NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    platform    TEXT   NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    -- The scrubbed event as JSON.
    data        TEXT   NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (project_id, event_id)
)
== table event_hourly (table event_hourly)
CREATE TABLE event_hourly (
    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    name       TEXT   NOT NULL,
    -- The hour's start, unix milliseconds.
    hour       BIGINT NOT NULL,
    -- Events sent by people (bots are only in bots).
    events     BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    -- The people's user ids as a mergeable sketch (internal/hll).
    users_hll  BLOB   NOT NULL,
    bots       BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    UNIQUE (project_id, hour, name)
)
== table hourly_stats (table hourly_stats)
CREATE TABLE hourly_stats (
    id                INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id        BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    route             TEXT   NOT NULL,
    -- The hour's start, unix milliseconds.
    hour              BIGINT NOT NULL,
    -- Page views by people (bots are only in bots).
    views             BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    -- The people's user ids as a mergeable sketch (internal/hll), so
    -- visitors of a day or week can be counted from the hours.
    visitors_hll      BLOB   NOT NULL,
    -- The page views with a duration (closed, plausible) and their sum.
    total_duration_ms BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    duration_count    BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    bots              BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    -- Error events on this route in this hour.
    errors            BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    UNIQUE (project_id, hour, route)
)
== table invite_projects (table invite_projects)
CREATE TABLE invite_projects (
    invite_id  BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES invites (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    project_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    PRIMARY KEY (invite_id, project_id)
)
== table invites (table invites)
CREATE TABLE invites (
    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    -- Trimmed and lowercase, like users.email.
    email      TEXT   NOT NULL,
    role       TEXT   NOT NULL,
    token_hash TEXT   NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    created_by BIGINT REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
    created_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
    expires_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
    -- Set when the invite was accepted; an invite works once.
    used_at    BIGINT
)
== table issues (table issues)
CREATE TABLE issues (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id  BIGINT  NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    fingerprint TEXT    NOT NULL,
    title       TEXT    NOT NULL,
    message     TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    culprit     TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    -- laravel, browser or the SDK platform.
    source      TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    level       TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT 'error',
    -- open, resolved or ignored.
    status      TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open',
    first_seen  BIGINT  NOT NULL,
    last_seen   BIGINT  NOT NULL,
    resolved_at BIGINT,
    times_seen  BIGINT  NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, regressed_at BIGINT, first_release TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', regressed_release TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    UNIQUE (project_id, fingerprint)
)
== table pageleaves (table pageleaves)
CREATE TABLE pageleaves (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id  BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    -- The uuid of the $pageleave event, so a resent one is stored once.
    event_id    TEXT   NOT NULL,
    -- The page view it closes ($pageview_id); '' when the SDK did not
    -- say, and then it closes the latest page view of its tab before it.
    pageview_id TEXT   NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    session_id  TEXT   NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    window_id   TEXT   NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    at          BIGINT NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (project_id, event_id)
)
== table pageviews (table pageviews)
CREATE TABLE pageviews (
    id                     INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id             BIGINT  NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    -- $pageview_id (posthog-js: the uuid of the $pageview event), so an
    -- SDK that sends the same page view again stores it once.
    pageview_id            TEXT    NOT NULL,
    -- $session_id and $window_id (one browser tab); '' when the SDK sent none.
    session_id             TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    window_id              TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    -- distinct_id: anonymous until the app calls identify.
    user_id                TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    route                  TEXT    NOT NULL,
    -- The URL's path, without query and fragment.
    path                   TEXT    NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    start                  BIGINT  NOT NULL,
    -- Time on the page: until its $pageleave or the next $pageview in the
    -- same tab, whichever came first. NULL while open, and when the time
    -- is not plausible (negative, or more than 6 hours).
    duration_ms            BIGINT,
    -- TRUE until something closes it: "the user left the page".
    left_without_pageleave BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT TRUE,
    -- Bots are stored but counted apart.
    is_bot                 BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    UNIQUE (project_id, pageview_id)
)
== table password_resets (table password_resets)
CREATE TABLE password_resets (
    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id    BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    token_hash TEXT   NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    created_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
    expires_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
    -- Set when the link was used; a reset link works once.
    used_at    BIGINT
)
== table project_access (table project_access)
CREATE TABLE project_access (
    user_id    BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    project_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    PRIMARY KEY (user_id, project_id)
)
== table projects (table projects)
CREATE TABLE projects (
    id                    INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name                  TEXT    NOT NULL,
    slug                  TEXT    NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    sentry_key            TEXT    NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    posthog_token         TEXT    NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    -- NULL keeps data forever.
    retention_days        INTEGER,
    tracks_laravel        BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    tracks_browser        BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    tracks_pageviews      BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    rate_limit_per_minute INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1000,
    created_at            BIGINT  NOT NULL
, slack_webhook_url TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', route_patterns TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]')
== table schema_migrations (table schema_migrations)
CREATE TABLE schema_migrations (
		version    INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
		name       TEXT    NOT NULL,
		applied_at BIGINT  NOT NULL
	)
== table sessions (table sessions)
CREATE TABLE sessions (
    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id    BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    token_hash TEXT   NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    -- Sent back by the dashboard in X-CSRF-Token on every change.
    csrf_token TEXT   NOT NULL,
    created_at BIGINT NOT NULL,
    -- Moves forward while the session is used (sliding expiry).
    expires_at BIGINT NOT NULL
)
== table settings (table settings)
CREATE TABLE settings (
    name       TEXT   PRIMARY KEY,
    value      TEXT   NOT NULL,
    updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL
)
== table source_maps (table source_maps)
CREATE TABLE source_maps (
    id          INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id  BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    -- The release the bundle was uploaded for; '' when it named none
    -- (uploads with debug ids need no release).
    release     TEXT   NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    dist        TEXT   NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    -- The file's URL as the bundle names it, such as ~/assets/index-D8xk2Lp1.js.map
    -- (~ stands for any scheme and host).
    file        TEXT   NOT NULL,
    -- source_map or minified_source.
    kind        TEXT   NOT NULL,
    -- The debug id that ties a minified file to its source map; '' without one.
    debug_id    TEXT   NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    -- For a minified file: the source map it points to (its Sourcemap
    -- header or sourceMappingURL), relative to file; '' when it names none.
    sourcemap   TEXT   NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    -- The SHA-1 of the bundle it came in, so the same bundle uploaded again
    -- is stored once.
    bundle      TEXT   NOT NULL,
    -- Relative to <DATA_DIR>/sourcemaps/.
    path        TEXT   NOT NULL,
    size        BIGINT NOT NULL,
    uploaded_at BIGINT NOT NULL
)
== table stats_dirty_hours (table stats_dirty_hours)
CREATE TABLE stats_dirty_hours (
    project_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    hour       BIGINT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (project_id, hour)
)
== table users (table users)
CREATE TABLE users (
    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    -- Trimmed and lowercase, so one address has one account.
    email         TEXT    NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    -- argon2id in PHC form: $argon2id$v=19$m=...,t=...,p=...$salt$hash
    password_hash TEXT    NOT NULL,
    -- admin or member.
    role          TEXT    NOT NULL,
    created_at    BIGINT  NOT NULL
)
